column4: A localized bacterial infection at a wound site. If untreated, can spread to bloodstream causing sepsis.
Systemic blood infection causing widespread inflammation. Life-threatening without immediate treatment.
A thrombus in the bloodstream. Can break loose and cause stroke or pulmonary embolism.
Traumatic brain injury causing temporary dysfunction. Requires rest to heal.
Circulatory collapse from trauma or blood loss. Body cannot maintain adequate blood flow.
Illness from contaminated food causing vomiting and diarrhea. Leads to rapid dehydration.
Illness from contaminated water. Causes severe gastrointestinal distress and dehydration.
Internal parasites consuming nutrients and causing weakness. Long-term effects if untreated.
Dangerously low body temperature. Causes confusion, drowsiness, and eventually cardiac arrest.
Dangerously high body temperature. Causes organ damage and death if not cooled rapidly.
Insufficient fluid levels in the body. Affects all bodily functions and can be fatal.
Prolonged lack of food causing the body to consume itself. Weakness and organ failure ensue.
